'''Bebel Gas''' was a [[container transport]], presumably belonging to the [[Bebel Gas|company]] that was present at [[Tinoon Station]] when a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Skirmish above Tinoon|raid]] took place. The raid consisted of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] and [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]] called [[Wraith (pirates)|Wraith]]. The raid was driven off by the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] security systems, as well as the assistance of [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] in the [[Otana/Legends|Otana]]. The ship's cargo was [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]].
